summary:
OK

Run: Thu Oct 22 2026. Scraped 25 posts from @milliesfillingstation. events.json unchanged (still valid JSON).

ADDED
- Nothing. No new post gave an explicit date for a new event.

EXPIRING SOON (ending within 7 days)
- Nothing. Autumn vendor market runs to Dec 19.

LIVE NOW (what a visitor sees today)
- Autumn vendor market, saturdays 8am-noon (no banner).
- Already ended and hidden by the site: hat burning workshop (Oct 2), autumn food market (Oct 10), saturday market (Oct 17). Hat burning entry can be removed after Nov 1 (30 days past end).
- Coming: Christmas open house, Sat Nov 7 8am, shows from Oct 31.

NEEDS YOUR EYES
- Oct 20 post (DeT8DyDzwxE) promotes "Saturday morning" with fall vibes and small businesses, but gives no date and no lineup. Probably the Oct 24 market. Not added. If you want a banner for Sat Oct 24, send the vendor lineup.
- Oct 18 post (Deov0lHxWB4): Syd (Sourdough by Syd) taking a two week break. Vendor-only, not added. She may be absent from the Oct 24 and Oct 31 markets.
- Oct 16 post (Dejexl3xV1H): "Saturday's forecast says FALL" (Oct 17 market recap). Nothing new.
- Oct 8 post (DePAARhxFlc): "Half the price! All the charm!" Looks like a sale, undated. Not added.
- Oct 6 post (DeKtxyJj7Th): third-party vendor promo for Oct 10. Past.
- Oct 10 post: vendor repost for Oct 10 market. Past.
- Hours: one vendor post (Sep 25) said 8am-1pm, Millie's own posts say 8am-noon. Left as 8am-noon.
- No closures, hour changes, yoga, puppy/rescue socials, or new workshops found in the last 25 posts. No post announcing the next Creative Arts Academy workshop date.
- Season wording on the site (fall/autumn text, "autumn vendor market" title) was not checked against the live site, only events.json. After Nov 7 the "autumn" naming may need to switch to a Christmas/winter theme.
